edges.reason: StandardToken.transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is used as the _from argument and as the allowance spender.
tx.origin keys the state[tx.origin]==0 allowance bypass check.
Whitelist lookup state[tx.origin] controls whether allowance is deducted.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from balanceOf without SafeMath.
Raw subtraction can underflow balanceOf[_from].
_from indexes into the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom invokes calcFee before crediting the recipient.
calcFee triggers an external call to the fee manager contract.
External call targets the hard-coded FeeManagement address.
Untrusted external call occurs while transfer state is mid-update, enabling re-entrancy.
_to receiver is credited in the balance update.
Fee returned by calcFee reduces the credited amount.
Unchecked addition/subtraction writes balanceOf[_to].
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall path.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall.
Target address a is fully attacker/owner controlled.
Delegatecall runs foreign bytecode in this contract storage context and can overwrite owner.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
_value is a multiplication operand for total.
_tos.length is the other multiplication operand for total.
Computed total bounds the balanceOf[msg.sender] subtraction.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total uses the unchecked local total.
_tos drives the recipient iteration index.
state[_to] = 1 permanently whitelists recipients, bypassing future allowance checks.
Loop index selects the balanceOf[_to] entry credited each iteration.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Constructor stores msg.sender as the privileged owner.
owner state variable is initialized from the deployer.
Constructor calls pairFor to compute the UNI pair address.
Constructor assigns the computed pair to the UNI state variable.
pairFor result flows into UNI, which gates the fee branch.
_msgSender returns msg.sender.
ERC20.transfer uses _msgSender for the sender.
ERC20.transfer delegates to internal _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls internal _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve to reduce allowance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance decrement.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping.
_approve mutates the _allowances mapping.
ERC20.approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance growth.
_mint credits the _balances mapping.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply reduction.
safeTransfer routes through the low-level call helper.
safeTransferFrom routes through the low-level call helper.
safeApprove routes through the low-level call helper.

callOptionalReturn performs the raw low-level call.
Low-level call hands control to an external token which may re-enter.
calcFee receives _from to test against owner and state.
calcFee receives _to to test against UNI.
calcFee receives _value passed to the fee library.
Local fee is returned by calcFee.
Constructor consumes the name argument.
Constructor consumes the symbol argument.
Constructor consumes the initial supply argument.
Attacker/owner supplied calldata b flows into the delegatecall.
calcFee return value is stored in the local fee used for the credit math.
_value is written into the allowance entry.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from exists only to index balances and gate the tx.origin whitelist inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _to is only used as the crediting key and UNI comparison inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the unchecked amount subtracted/credited inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
Local fee only feeds the recipient credit computation in StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key in StandardToken.approve.
Parameter _value is only the allowance value written by StandardToken.approve.
Parameter _tos only drives the recipient loop in StandardToken.batchSend.
Parameter _value is only the per-recipient amount in StandardToken.batchSend.
Local total is only the unchecked product used in StandardToken.batchSend.
Local i is only the loop counter that writes state and balances in StandardToken.batchSend.
Parameter a is only the delegatecall target in StandardToken.delegate.
Parameter b is only the delegatecall calldata in StandardToken.delegate.
Parameter _from is only inspected against owner/state in StandardToken.calcFee.
Parameter _to is only compared against UNI in StandardToken.calcFee.
Parameter _value is only forwarded to the fee library in StandardToken.calcFee.
Local fee is only the returned value of StandardToken.calcFee.
Constructor name argument is only stored into the name state variable.
Constructor symbol argument is only stored into the symbol state variable.
Constructor supply argument is only assigned to totalSupply and the deployer balance.
